title: Sagrada Familia visit
text:
Very good experience, very interesting guided tour with a pleasant guide.
However, expensive price for a 1-hour tour when it is sold as 1.5 hours.
author: christellemW2380WO

title: Simple beauty with city view
text:
Gothic church in El Born. Elaborate exterior with open, spacious interior. Not full of art or statues like most cathedrals. Simple and stunning. Can walk up the bell tower for wonderful view of city, Guell park hill and port. 

Many shops and restaurants surround this very old church. Enjoy the old with the new
author: sarahcB4578MX
